text: A habitat is a living thing’s home. From the tallest mountain to the deepest ocean, the chances of finding living things anywhere on Earth are very high. This is because living things evolve over time to be able to survive, even in extreme habitats.

atoms.word: h a b i t a t

instruction.text: This is a map that shows you which areas are hotter and colder on Earth.

text: The colours of this thermometer tell you where it is <t-red>hot</t-red> and where it is <t-blue>cold</t-blue>.

atoms.a: Select the area on the map that is the hottest.
Select the area on the map that is the coldest.

end.text: The temperature of an area has an enormous influence on the habitat and on the animals living there.

instruction.text: Match the picture of the habitat with the correct description.

trainers.hint: Select an image to listen to the name of the habitat.

atoms.a: a very dry and hot habitat
a wet, salty and huge habitat
